description: This source file defines the 'Env' class, which manages environment variables for a Flutter application, including loading variables from .env/.env.example files and providing accessors for specific variables like 'baseUrl'.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A utility class for loading environment variables and accessing configuration values such as 'baseUrl'.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the '.env' file, with a fallback to '.env.example' if the main file is not available. Ensures variables are loaded only once.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Getter that returns the 'BASE_URL' environment variable, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001' if not set or empty.
